title: How a Godly Man Handles Being the Smartest Guy in the Room
caption:
You're not wrong to know the answer first.

You're wrong when you need everyone to watch you know it.

Proverbs 27:5 says open rebuke beats hidden love, but it never says it has to happen in front of the room.

Be right quietly. Let someone else be right out loud.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #humility #wisdom
